verdicts.reason: Both candidates break up the original's centred 'HOHOHO AGENCY' lockup. In each, the decorative confetti is squashed into a cramped, mangled strip trailing off 'HOHOHO', and the blue ring and triangle sit as scattered fragments with large dead white areas around them. A is worse because a big empty gap separates 'HOHOHO' from 'AGENCY', so the brand name reads as two unrelated pieces. B keeps the name and 'Office Secret Santa' in a tighter block, but it still leaves a lopsided empty area at the bottom right.
